headline: GOLD ERASES 2026 GAINS ON 70% HIKE ODDS — $4,374 Spot Ahead Of Friday NFP; Silver Down 2.7% To $64.76
snippet: Gold fell to $4,374.54 per ounce on September 3 — down $71.13 (-1.60%) and erasing nearly all of its 2026 year-to-date gains — as the 10-year Treasury yield pushed to 4.79% and Fed Chair Warsh's Jackson Hole 'work to do' language drove September hike odds from 39% a week ago to 66–70% via CME FedWatch; silver fell a steeper 2.69% to $64.76. Friday's August Non-farm Payrolls report is now the make-or-break data point: a miss below consensus would likely collapse hike pricing and trigger a sharp reversal, while an in-line or beat print would confirm the September 16 hike and extend the correction toward $4,200 technical support.

headline: GREENLAND MINES CLOSES SARFARTOQ — $35M Buys 34% Of Non-China NdPr Potential; US$2.05B NPV At 118% IRR In Greenland
snippet: Greenland Mines Ltd completed its acquisition of the Sarfartoq Neodymium-Praseodymium Rare Earths Project in southwest Greenland on September 2, paying C$20 million cash plus C$15 million in securities to acquire Neo North Star Resources. At 2025 consumption levels, Sarfartoq Phase 1 alone would represent approximately 34% of all NdPr oxide refined outside China — a strategic asset for permanent magnet supply chains serving EV and defence sectors. The project holds Indicated Mineral Resources of 6.9 Mt at 1.60% TREO with a high-case pre-tax NPV of US$2.05 billion at a 118.6% IRR across a nine-year mine life; Greenland Government approval was secured ahead of close.

headline: NFP DAY: GOLD'S $4,200 vs $4,500 FORK — Advantage Gold Maps The September Decision Tree For Friday Jobs Report
snippet: Friday's August Non-farm Payrolls is the final major data point before the September 16 FOMC decision, and Advantage Gold maps the asymmetric two-path setup: a payrolls miss would collapse the 66% September hike probability and likely drive a 5–10% single-session gold recovery toward $4,500, while a beat locks in the hike and drives gold toward the $4,200 technical support zone. The key insight for junior mining investors is that gold equities are already priced for the hike scenario — downside from a beat is limited while upside from a miss is front-loaded, making Thursday the most asymmetric entry point for speculative long positions in several months.

headline: MAHARREY: FOREVER GOLD BULL MARKET — $6.28T In US FY2026 Spending Against $40T Debt Creates Irreversible Structural Gold Demand
snippet: Money Metals Exchange analyst Mike Maharrey argues September 2 that the United States has entered a structurally permanent gold bull market driven by fiscal dynamics no political cycle can reverse: the federal government has spent $6.28 trillion in FY2026 — up 3.3% year-over-year — against $40 trillion in outstanding debt, and an analyst quoted in the piece says he sees 'no off-ramp' in the current trajectory. Gold has appreciated against every major currency over the past 25 years regardless of interest rate cycles, and Maharrey's thesis is that the January 2026 record above $5,400 per ounce is not a cyclical peak but the first major milestone in a generational repricing of monetary metal.

headline: GOLDSEEK SWOT: PALLADIUM, PRECIOUS METALS RALLY AS ADP MISS RESHAPES SEPTEMBER RATE-HIKE CALCULUS
snippet: U.S. Global Investors' weekly SWOT analysis highlights the ADP private payrolls miss (38,000 vs 47,000 expected) as the week's principal strength for precious metals, with palladium responding most sharply on compounding supply fears from the Sibanye-Stillwater East strike threatening Montana's 284,000-ounce annual PGM output. The report flags gold's persistent divergence from real yields as a structural signal: the historical correlation between gold prices and 10-year TIPS yields has broken down at current levels, suggesting that sovereign debt sustainability concerns — not rate positioning alone — are underpinning physical gold demand from central banks and institutional buyers.

headline: COPPER SPOT PREMIUM HITS 4-YEAR HIGH — 42 Consecutive Stockpile Sessions; Jefferies Projects 442K-Tonne 2026 Global Deficit
snippet: LME copper stockpiles have fallen for 42 consecutive trading sessions — the longest streak since 2014 — to approximately 205,000 tonnes, with nearly half of remaining inventory already cancelled for removal; the spot premium has widened to $478 per tonne above the three-month contract, the highest since 2021, signalling severe near-term supply tightness. Jefferies projects a 442,000-tonne global copper deficit in 2026 widening to 782,000 tonnes by 2030, compounded by Chile tracking a 2.6% output decline and major miners posting a 3.9% collective Q2 production miss. For junior copper developers in established mining jurisdictions, the convergence of physical tightness and forward deficit projections represents the structural setup that historically precedes the most significant equity re-ratings.

headline: ZAMBIA EYES $1.8B FROM FORMALISED ARTISANAL GOLD — UAE Imported $1.8B While Zambia Reported Only $128M; Ghana State-Board Model To Channel Small-Scale Output
snippet: ZCCM Investments Holdings CEO Kakenenwa Muyangwa outlined plans September 2 to formalise Zambia's small-scale gold sector using Ghana's centralised gold board model, targeting the vast discrepancy between declared exports and foreign import records: the UAE imported $1.8 billion of Zambian gold in 2023 while Zambia's official central bank statistics showed exports of just $128 million. ZCCM-IH intends to become the official government purchasing agent, channelling artisanal and small-scale miner output through a formal market — 1,498 artisanal licences have been issued since 2023 — with the formalisation effort expected to significantly raise Zambia's profile as a gold-producing nation in global metal trade statistics.

headline: SONORO GOLD DISCOVERS NEW EL QUINCE ZONE — 9.14m At 3.08 g/t Au In Cerro Caliche Mexico; 50,000m Campaign Advances Resource Envelope
snippet: Sonoro Gold Corp. released September 1 initial assay results from the first 10,000 metres of a 50,000-metre campaign at the Cerro Caliche gold project in Sonora, Mexico, identifying El Quince as a significant new mineralised zone alongside best infill intersection SCR-348: 9.14 metres at 3.076 g/t gold and 26.10 g/t silver. Infill drilling confirmed geological continuity within and beyond existing resource limits, step-out holes confirmed lateral and depth extensions of the northwest-trending mineralised corridors, and areas previously classified as waste at the Buena Suerte vein zone were confirmed mineralised — materially expanding the resource envelope before 40,000 additional metres of the campaign have even been drilled.

headline: ROXMORE RESOURCES DRILLS 94.5m AT 0.73 g/t AU AT CONVERSE NEVADA — Three-Rig Battle Mountain Program Advances Toward 2027 Pre-Feasibility Study
snippet: Roxmore Resources Inc. released September 1 additional infill and extension assay results from the Converse Gold Project at Nevada's Battle Mountain-Eureka Gold Trend, with hole CV26-022 returning 94.5 metres at 0.73 g/t gold and 2.34 g/t silver, and CV26-017 returning 85.3 metres at 0.52 g/t gold — both confirming consistent bulk-tonnage continuity at one of Nevada's premier Carlin-type addresses. The program has expanded to three active drill rigs with additional equipment expected imminently, advancing toward a planned Pre-Feasibility Study in 2027; at gold above $4,300 per ounce, the economics of a large-volume Carlin-type Nevada system through PFS represent a compelling risk-adjusted setup for investors who follow the discovery curve into a formal resource.

headline: UPSIDE GOLD SURPASSES KENA TARGET — 5,180m In 19 Holes Exceeds 4,000m BC Gold-Copper Plan; NI 43-101 Resource Update Due Q1 2027
snippet: Upside Gold Corp. (CSE: UG) announced September 2 the completion of its expanded 2026 drilling program at the Kena Gold-Copper Project in southeastern British Columbia, completing 5,180 metres in 19 diamond drill holes — 30% above the original 4,000-metre plan — after encountering priority targets across the Kena Copper-Gold, Kena Gold, Gold Mountain, and South Gold zones. Results will be integrated with the 2025 program and historical drilling for a full NI 43-101 mineral resource estimate update incorporating gold, copper, and silver economics, with the estimate targeted for Q1 2027; for investors in B.C. junior gold-copper explorers, an updated NI 43-101 integrating modern drill data is the typical step-change catalyst that drives initial institutional attention.
